title: Experiment Journal Entry
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of experiment-journaler. Records the provenance of one run (config/data/git/seed) AND the ACTUAL train/test pipeline facts that really ran, so train-test-parity-verifier can mechanically re-check that the alignment contract held post-run (catching designed-vs-executed drift).

designed_train.description: pipeline facts the DESIGN stage specified for train (same shape the alignment checker consumes); parity-verifier compares actual against this to catch designed-vs-executed drift

designed_test.description: pipeline facts the DESIGN stage specified for test/eval

actual_train.description: pipeline facts that ACTUALLY ran for train (same shape the alignment checker consumes)

actual_test.description: pipeline facts that ACTUALLY ran for test/eval
